premises.text: Charging pads force contact, block phone use, and charge only one device per pad section
premises.evidence_span: You can't use your phone while it's charging. It's kind of ugly. And worst of all, each section of pad can only charge one device at a time

premises.text: Magnetic-field bending math enables truly contactless wireless power
premises.evidence_span: an historic mathematical proof that unlocked the solution to wireless power by the bending of magnetic fields

premises.text: Pi charges multiple devices simultaneously at different angles while users keep using them
premises.evidence_span: We've got five devices now charging simultaneously at different angles from just one pie

premises.text: Cases bridge legacy phones and tablets lacking magnetic receivers; Qi phones will not need cases
premises.evidence_span: We built these cases to enable people with popular legacy devices to be able to charge, as well as to charge your tablets, which don't have magnetic receivers

premises.text: Safe magnetic charging is FCC-compliant unlike microwave/ultrasound/laser approaches
premises.evidence_span: we built Pi around a safe magnetic charging standard

premises.text: Patented platform powers multiple devices at any angle, overcoming parallel-only magnetic limits
premises.evidence_span: our patented platform can power multiple devices at any angle. It's safe, it's affordable, and it's FCC compliant

premises.text: Business model sells Pi to consumers and opens the platform to consumer-electronics OEMs
premises.evidence_span: First, we will sell Pi directly to consumers. We have over 50% gross margins and anticipate a very high lifetime value per customer

value.text: Truly wireless charging that frees users from pads and tangled wires
value.evidence_span: So how do we get truly wireless charging?

causal_links.evidence_span: thanks to our incredible team and Leeshan's breakthrough, our patented platform can power multiple devices at any angle
introducing Pi, the world's first contactless wireless charging device
we will sell Pi directly to consumers
